engine.notes: WebSearch was exhausted session-wide before any query for this city ran (200/200 used, consistent with concurrent sibling work on other cities) -- all five intended discovery searches were rejected immediately, so Priority 2 relied on direct WebFetch only, per the brief's contingency. All ten archive organisations were re-verified live via direct fetch with no closures, moves, or rebrands found. D

entries.name: The Groundlings Theatre & School
entries.summary: Non-profit sketch and improv theatre and school running since 1974, with a structured training path from intro workshops to its Sunday and Main companies.
entries.schedule: Core Track auditions held weekly (Tuesdays); new online classes posted every Monday; sketch shows run regularly at its t
signals: Founded 1974 by Gary Austin
501(c)(3) non-profit theatre
Core Track auditions held weekly
Described on-site as one of the leading improv training programs in the country
entries.reasons: Five decades running its own theatre with the deepest beginner-to-company class pipeline of any LA school, and a continuously updated schedule.

entries.name: Impro Theatre
entries.summary: Long-running company performing fully improvised plays in the styles of classic literature and theatre, with its own school (the C.O.R.E. program) and a calendar of shows, jams and events.
entries.schedule: Multiple shows weekly (Wednesday, Friday, Sunday per current listings); ongoing jams and events calendar.
signals: Operating 37+ years
Home venue in Los Feliz Village
C.O.R.E. training program for all experience levels
Recent professional productions streamed (e.g. Tennessee Williams Unscripted)
entries.reasons: A long-standing company with its own venue, a distinctive genre-based repertoire, a structured school, and an active current show and jam calendar.

entries.name: Pack Theater
entries.summary: Comedy theatre and school at 1615 N. Vermont Ave. offering live improv, sketch, stand-up and variety shows six nights a week alongside a broad class program taught by working industry professionals.
entries.schedule: Shows run six nights a week; class registration ongoing in-person and online.
signals: Venue at 1615 N. Vermont Ave., Los Feliz
Past LA Weekly Readers' Choice Best Comedy Venue / Best Theater Company
Classes include improv, sketch, character, stand-up, TV pilot writing, voiceover and clown
House team auditions and sketch team submissions open
entries.reasons: An owned venue with shows nearly every night and an unusually wide class catalogue taught by recognised industry instructors, though no founding date is published.

entries.name: Improv-LA
entries.summary: Boutique improv school with locations in Burbank, Silver Lake and Los Feliz, running a four-level class progression plus comedy-writing and voiceover training, and corporate team-building workshops.
entries.schedule: Weekly in-person group classes across levels 1-4, plus an on-demand streaming course and periodic intensives.
signals: Founded by a Guinness World Record holder for longest improv show
Forbes recognition and four-time LA Community Award winner
Over 100,000 students taught
Copyright year current (2026)
entries.reasons: A well-regarded, long-running school with real scale and recent press recognition, scored down because its own site foregrounds classes over a public show calendar.

entries.name: LA Connection Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: Burbank improv theatre founded in 1977 by Kent Skov, running a four-week introductory class pipeline into performance groups plus weekly live shows.
entries.schedule: Weekly live performances; four-week introductory classes with private coaching also available.
signals: Founded 1977
Own venue at 3435 West Magnolia Blvd, Burbank
Notable alumni include Will Ferrell, Matthew Perry and Josh Groban
Corporate client list includes NBC, Disney and Universal
entries.reasons: Nearly fifty years in the same Burbank venue and a strong alumni pedigree, scored down because the site shows little detail on current show scheduling or class levels beyond the introductory tier.

entries.name: World's Greatest Improv School (WGIS)
entries.summary: Improv school operating in Los Angeles, New York and online, with leveled classes, specialty workshops (musical, hip-hop, D&D-themed improv), and performance opportunities through resident teams.
entries.schedule: Classes scheduled through at least November; most multi-class courses include a show.
signals: Classes held at 1615 N. Vermont Ave., Los Angeles
Levels from Intro through Advanced plus specialty workshops
Operates in LA, NYC and online
Drop-in sessions offered for experienced improvisers
entries.reasons: A multi-city school with a clear leveled curriculum and current scheduling, scored down for a thinner public show calendar than the dedicated theatres.

entries.name: Fanatic Salon Theater
entries.summary: Culver City performance space offering improv drop-in workshops, teen improv classes, stand-up and musical improv shows, staffed by Second City ETC alumni.
entries.schedule: Saturday improv drop-in at 11am; musical improv and comedy shows on weekends; Wednesday writer/performer/artist program.
signals: Venue at 3815 Sawtelle Blvd, Culver City
Staff includes Second City ETC founders Jeff Michalski and Jane Morris
Teen improv program
October 2026 events currently listed
entries.reasons: Notable Second City pedigree and a current, varied weekly calendar, scored down because no founding date or class-level structure is published.

entries.name: M.I.'s Westside Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Santa Monica comedy theatre running nightly stand-up, improv and sketch shows, with classes at multiple levels, kids' classes, and an improv jam/open mic.
entries.schedule: Seven shows a week; Friday improv at 10pm, Saturday shows at 8 and 10pm, Sunday class showcases.
signals: Venue at 1323-A 3rd St, Santa Monica
Weekly 'Mission: IMPROVable' improv show
Class showcases and graduations run regularly
Guest performer roster includes well-known comedians
entries.reasons: A real, frequently-running venue with classes and a weekly improv jam, scored down because its programming leans heavily stand-up and the schedule we could verify showed dates a year old.

entries.name: Improv for the People (IFTP)
entries.summary: Studio-model improv school at the Pico Theater running flex-level, month-to-month classes alongside a Saturday night audience-suggestion show.
entries.schedule: Classes Monday-Wednesday evenings and Saturday mornings; Saturday night shows.
signals: Based at The Pico Theater, 10508 W Pico Blvd
Month-to-month 'flex-level' studio model
Multiple named instructors
$185/month for four classes
entries.reasons: A clear, current class schedule and a real venue, scored down for a single weekly show and no stated founding date or press/alumni standing.

entries.name: Michelle Danner Acting Studio (Improv LA)
entries.summary: Improv program within Michelle Danner's Culver City acting studio, offering adult and teen/youth improv classes that culminate in a class showcase.
entries.schedule: Weekly sessions Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday; online and in-person.
signals: Based at 10820 Washington Blvd, Culver City
Adult (Improv 101) and teen/youth (ages 9-18) tracks
Runs within a broader, established acting studio
2025 copyright shown on the improv page
entries.reasons: A real, current class offering, scored low because it is a single-level add-on to a general acting studio with no public shows, house teams, or stated founding date for the improv program itself.
